description: CDASH CMDOSU (C78417) -- Concomitant Medication Dose Units. All 8 official CDISC submission values included, plus 1 sponsor extension (other) that both BioIVT studies actively use but which is not in the official C78417 subset. Both studies already agreed with each other on this field (MG/MCG/G/ML/IU/OTHER) but neither matched the real CDASH case-sensitive submission values (mg not MG, ug not MCG, etc).
source: NCI EVS CDISC CDASH Controlled Terminology, CMDOSU C78417, fetched 2026-09-28 from https://evs.nci.nih.gov/ftp1/CDISC/SDTM/CDASH%20Terminology.pdf
